methodologyNotes: Specs sourced from manufacturer product pages, riderguide.com (independent tested-specs database with 247+ scooters tested), apolloscooters.co, gotrax.com, turboant.com, and unagiscooters.com. riderguide.com served as the primary data source for most products since it publishes both manufacturer claims and real-world tested figures. Manufacturer pages used as authoritative for tire type and load capacity where riderguide differed. Gotrax G4 tire type: gotrax.com (manufacturer) explicitly states solid puncture-resistant; riderguide labels it tubed — manufacturer used as authoritative. Gotrax GMAX gotrax.com product page /products/gmax-ultra-electric-scooter confirmed. Apollo models sourced from apolloscooters.co (manufacturer) and corroborated by riderguide.com. TurboAnt M10 Lite sourced from turboant.com official blog; product page returned 404; tire type null (unconfirmed). Xiaomi Electric Scooter 4 Pro is a Europe/Asia-primary SKU; no US retail price confirmed; excluded from dataset. Segway E2 US price could not be confirmed from reachable sources. priceUsd = US MSRP or current retail starting price; sale prices used where MSRP unavailable but noted. motor_w = continuous rated watts (not peak). range_mi = manufacturer claimed maximum. weight_lb = scooter weight. A null beats any guess. All sources accessed 2026-06-15.
